title: Dermalogica Daily Microfoliant Review: Rice Enzymes + Salicylic Acid, How to Use It
description:
Dermalogica Daily Microfoliant: a rice-based exfoliating powder for brighter, smoother skin, recommended for all skin types and gentle enough for daily use.

We earn a commission if you buy through our link.

• Rice-based exfoliating powder that activates on contact with water
• Releases papain, salicylic acid and rice enzymes to polish skin
• Skin Brightening Complex of phytic acid from rice bran, white tea and licorice helps balance uneven skin tone
• Colloidal oatmeal and allantoin help calm skin
• Mix half a teaspoon with water into a paste, massage for one minute avoiding the eyes, rinse; adjust frequency if irritation occurs
